|Error Analysis                                                                                    |
|    An exception has occurred in class "CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE". This exception was not                 |
|     caught                                                                                       |
|    in procedure "IF_OO_ADT_CLASSRUN~MAIN" "(METHOD)" or propagated by a RAISING                  |
|     clause.                                                                                      |
|    Since the caller of the procedure could not have anticipated this                             |
|    exception, the current program was terminated.                                                |
|    The reason for the exception occurring was:                                                   |
|    The reason for the exception is:                                                              |
|    In the current program "ZMCP_SHR_DUMP_CLS=============CP", a division                         |
|     ('DIVIDE', '/', 'DIV' or 'MOD')                                                              |
|    attempted to use operands of type I or INT8 to divide by 0.                                   |
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
|How to correct the error                                                                          |
|    If the exception cannot be prevented, "CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE" must be caught within                |
|    procedure "IF_OO_ADT_CLASSRUN~MAIN" "(METHOD)" or declared in the procedure's                 |
|     RAISING clause.                                                                              |
|    To prevent the exception, note the following:                                                 |
|                                                                                                  |
|    If the error occurs in one of your own ABAP programs or an SAP program                        |
|    that you have modified, try to remedy the error.                                              |
|    If the error occurs in a non-modfied SAP program, you might be able to                        |
|    find a solution in the SAP Notes system. If you have access to the SAP                        |
|    Notes system, check there first using the following keywords:                                 |
|                                                                                                  |
|    "COMPUTE_INT_ZERODIVIDE" CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE                                                     |
|    "ZMCP_SHR_DUMP_CLS=============CP" bzw. ZMCP_SHR_DUMP_CLS=============CM001                   |
|    "IF_OO_ADT_CLASSRUN~MAIN"                                                                     |
|    If you cannot solve the problem yourself, please send the following                           |
|    information to SAP:                                                                           |
|                                                                                                  |
|    1. The description of the problem (short dump)                                                |
|    Please press the "Local File” button in the current display.                                  |
|                                                                                                  |
|    2. The relevant system log                                                                    |

|    interval to ten minutes before the short dump and five minutes after                          |
